episode_summary: Gwen Snyder shares her approach to building a successful luxury real estate business without cold calling, focusing on relationship building and client service. She emphasizes the importance of follow-up, proactive client management, and high-quality marketing to drive referrals and maintain a strong presence in the competitive luxury market.
